===== 任务287696 11-23 04:22:39 =====
--- 命令 ---
echo "===== 部署 plugins/ai_chat.py $(date '+%F %T') ====="
cd /root/bot/bot
B64=''
# 1) 备份线上原文(若存在)
if [ -f "plugins/ai_chat.py" ]; then cp -f "plugins/ai_chat.py" "plugins/ai_chat.py.bak_1123" && echo "已备份 -> plugins/ai_chat.py.bak_1123"; else echo "线上无此文件,跳过备份"; fi
# 2) 解码+解压还原
printf '%s' "$B64" | base64 -d 2>/dev/null | gzip -dc > "plugins/ai_chat.py.new"
if [ $? -ne 0 ] || [ ! -s "plugins/ai_chat.py.new" ]; then echo "【失败】解码/解压失败,不覆盖线上"; exit 1; fi
# 3) 校验新文件md5
GOT=$(md5sum "plugins/ai_chat.py.new" | awk '{print $1}')
echo "期望md5=1e55a0df0801ead47e30c7fcb3ca2b55"
echo "实际md5=$GOT"
if [ "$GOT" != "1e55a0df0801ead47e30c7fcb3ca2b55" ]; then echo "【失败】md5不符,不覆盖线上,删除临时"; rm -f "plugins/ai_chat.py.new"; exit 1; fi
# 4) 语法校验
/root/bot/venv/bin/python -m py_compile "plugins/ai_chat.py.new" 2>&1 && echo "语法OK" || { echo "【失败】语法错误,不覆盖线上"; rm -f "plugins/ai_chat.py.new"; exit 1; }
# 5) 原子替换
mv -f "plugins/ai_chat.py.new" "plugins/ai_chat.py" && echo "【成功】plugins/ai_chat.py 已覆盖"
md5sum "plugins/ai_chat.py"
echo "===== 部署 plugins/ai_chat.py 完 ====="
